candidate_selection.metric: per-session centered variance-weighted R2, unweighted six-session mean
candidate_selection.rule: fixed output EMA alpha=1/3; earliest finite maximum across all 24 epochs

provenance_disclosure.source_producer_no_query_arrays_or_label: payload materialization/export only; source training and public dev scoring receipts are retained as provenance
provenance_disclosure.source_training_scope: formal source_train supervised producer training is retained as provenance; export and target parameters are not updated

runtime_input.absolute_position_contract: A_flat offline windows use padded_window_start - 49 + arange(50); E_nope_flat explicitly disables PE; streaming resets core state at each session
runtime_input.operation: identity float32; observed [B,96] enters raw5/frontend directly
runtime_input.output_scale: inference EMA is applied to decoder score; resulting state is divided by 5 to native M2 units
runtime_input.padding: negative absolute positions are left-padding metadata and valid mask excludes them before temporal KV

source_pretrained_encoder.role: frozen-A association-profile bank; exact available B3S source remains provenance, not a runtime dependency
